output.headline: Intermountain Health: a strategic buyer whose one deal, a $789M platform investment, was in the target's own sub-sector, though none in the Midwest.
output.differentiator: Intermountain Health's $789M median deal is the largest on any peer line, and its one deal, a closed platform investment, was in the target's own sub-sector.

acquirer_overview.title: A Salt Lake City strategic buyer with a single, closed platform deal
points: Intermountain Health is headquartered in Salt Lake City, with 33 hospitals in Utah, Colorado, Idaho and Montana; it left Kansas in 2024 [P:2].
It completed a merger with SCL Health, extending into Colorado, Kansas and Montana [P:1].
Its record is one deal, in 2022, which closed (1 of 1, 100%). Buyer revenue has not been researched [K:closed_share, T:record, V:synergy].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Sub-sector match is the case for Intermountain Health; region and depth are not
points: Share of its deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; margin fit is a modest factor and deal size a slight one [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit, S:not_bigger].
Against: deals in recent years is a slight negative factor, and it has no deal in the target's region [S:recency, T:record].
It sits 10th of 10 on the priority list, with a likelihood of 3.6% [R:rank].

precedent_activity.title: One 2022 platform deal in the target's sub-sector, at 12.5x
points: Paramount Care Partners: Healthcare Services, $789M, Platform Investment, 2022, 12.5x EV/EBITDA and 3.03x EV/Revenue, closed [D:MA-2022-0183].
The deal was Multi-Regional, so none of its deals are in the Midwest, and 0 of 1 fall in the $100M-$400M size band [K:by_region, K:size_band].
It was a control deal (1 of 1, 100%). There is no record in adjacent provider sub-sectors [K:control_share, T:record].

valuation_context.title: A 75th-percentile ask is defensible; its own pricing sits near the median
points: 70 comparable deals in the $100M-$400M band price at 10.7x (25th percentile), 12.8x (median) and 15.3x (75th percentile) EV/EBITDA [V:comps].
The 75th percentile is defensible: the target's 16.8% margin is above the comps' median of 12.9% and above 87% of comparable deals [V:comps].
Its median paid of 12.5x is just under the comparable median. Cost synergy headroom of $15M-$25M is the only measure of ability to pay [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Its only deal, at $789M, is far from the target's $200M and outside the comparable size band.
risk_flags.mitigant: A deal no bigger than its largest is a slight factor in its favour [S:not_bigger].
risk_flags.reality: 0 of 1 deals fall in the $100M-$400M band; no deal of this size is shown [K:size_band].

risk_flags.title: Thin record, no Midwest deal
risk_flags.concern: One deal and no Midwest transaction; the footprint is Western and it left Kansas in 2024.
risk_flags.mitigant: The SCL Health merger shows it has extended into new states before [P:1].
risk_flags.reality: Conviction is Low, and peers such as Advocate Health show deeper sub-sector records [T:record, P:2, C:conviction].

risk_flags.title: Price below the upper quartile
risk_flags.concern: A 75th-percentile ask of 15.3x is well above the 12.5x it paid before.
risk_flags.mitigant: Cost synergy headroom of $15M-$25M could support a higher bid [V:synergy].
risk_flags.reality: Its median paid of 12.5x is below the 75th percentile, and buyer revenue is not researched [V:comps, V:synergy].

conviction.rationale: Only 1 deal in the target's own sub-sector, none in adjacent provider sub-sectors, and no deal in the target's region, so the evidence is too thin for higher conviction [T:record, C:conviction].
